QuestInfo.name: Wigging Out
QuestInfo.0: Tina still has a job to do. She's thinking about trying a new concept for the event.
QuestInfo.1: Tina is thinking about a cool and chic blonde-hair concept. She wants you to go to the #b5th and 6th floor#k and bring back wigs from the Female Mannequins for you to take to Marshall, the hairstylist. Marshall is sure to have some fabulous ideas.
QuestInfo.2: You brought the wigs to Marshall.

0.0: What? ...Ooh, Blake is getting impossible to deal with. HE asked for that kind of outfit! I KNEW it would be ridiculous and yet I still went with his idea, and now this? Sigh. Well, it's part of my job...if it wasn't for Lana....
0.1: Fine. If he's got a problem with the bunny suit, maybe a wig will do. I want a hair style that'll complement his new song. Could you bring back some blonde wigs from the #b5th and 6th floors#k off the Female Mannequins?

yes.0: Could you bring #b50 wigs#k for Marshall? I'm sure he'll come up with a style for Blake. Thank you!

no.0: Hey, if Blake is getting under your skin, I totally understand...

1.0: Did Tina send you? Let me see the wigs. Hey, not bad not bad! I can definitely work with these. Hm, how fabulous do we want to go...

yes.0: Let me show you the magic I can perform with hair. Be amazed!

npc.0: Get the wigs from Female Mannequins on the 5th and 6th floor. About 50 should do it for Marshall.

item.0: What is it? I'm not taking any more jobs at the moment until I'm done with Tina's request.
